paper.title: A Real-World WebAgent with Planning, Long Context Understanding, and Program Synthesis
paper.central_claim: WebAgent(HTML-T5 规划+HTML 摘要,Flan-U-PaLM 程序合成,self-experience 监督)使真实网站成功率提高超过 50%,HTML-T5 在 MiniWoB++ 高 18.7% 并在 Mind2Web 达 SoTA(作者原主张)

provenance.receipt_ref_note: no receipt/run-record path exposed to the worker; session_id taken from CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID

missing_sections: Figure 3/5/6/8/9 images (flow, example episodes, Fig 9 numbers)
Appendix D/G example prompts are figure-only (no listing text in render)

evidence.quote: We empirically demonstrate that our modular recipe improves the success on real websites by over 50%, and that HTML-T5 is the best model to solve various HTML understanding tasks; achieving 18.7% higher success rate than the prior method on MiniWoB web automation benchmark, and SoTA performance on Mind2Web, an offline task planning evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张(多主张:系统+组件)

evidence.quote: WebAgent notably improves the success rate by over 50% in real websites.
evidence.support_explanation: 贡献条目

evidence.quote: However, web automation on real-world websites has still suffered from (1) the lack of pre-defined action space, (2) much longer HTML documents than simulated observations, and (3) the absence of domain-specific knowledge for understanding HTML documents
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap

evidence.quote: Compared to simulator (about 0.5K tokens on average), HTML tokens of real websites are much longer (from 7K to 14K), which takes up the context length of large language models.
evidence.support_explanation: gap 证据:HTML token 统计

evidence.quote: MindAct ( Deng et al., 2023 ) could be the most relevant work, where finetuned language model summarizes the raw HTML document into task-relevant snippets, and another model predicts the web actions in a multi-choice QA format.
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻 MindAct

evidence.quote: While MindAct also combines several language models, it has just adopted DeBERTa ( He et al., 2021 ) and Flan-T5 ( Chung et al., 2022 ) for summarization and actor modules, and evaluated it on the offline dataset.
evidence.support_explanation: 与 MindAct 的差异陈述

evidence.quote: This iterative process of planning, summarization, and program synthesis continues until a designated end-of-episode sub-instruction is predicted or the maximum number of iterations is reached.
evidence.support_explanation: WebAgent 循环;最大迭代数取值未给

evidence.quote: It processes HTML in a text-to-text manner and employs local and global attention mechanisms ( Ainslie et al., 2020 ) in the encoder to capture the hierarchical structure of long HTML inputs.
evidence.support_explanation: HTML-T5 结构先验(借自 LongT5)

evidence.quote: Our final dataset has 3.41M examples. We pre-train HTML-T5 for 100K iterations
evidence.support_explanation: 预训练数据/步数

evidence.quote: In this method, manually curated scripts generate planning and summarization steps, while Flan-U-PaLM is tasked with generating Python programs.
evidence.support_explanation: self-experience supervision 定义

evidence.quote: To refine the learning experience, we utilize environmental feedback to eliminate critical failures, such as program execution errors, retriever errors, and clearly erroneous URL prefixes
evidence.support_explanation: 过滤规则(仅剔除关键失败)

evidence.quote: We sample instructions by randomly assigning values to placeholders from pre-defined key-value pairs.
evidence.support_explanation: 训练指令由模板+键值采样

evidence.quote: We employ a rule-based parser to decompose instructions into sequences of sub-instructions; corresponding reference IDs are retrieved from HTML using regular expressions.
evidence.support_explanation: 规划/摘要监督由规则解析器+正则产生

evidence.quote: we introduce the act via programming paradigm in web automation by utilizing the conditional code generation capabilities of LLMs
evidence.support_explanation: 代码即动作空间

evidence.quote: Through the self-experience supervision process, we curate 260 episodes on real estate website, 230 episodes on social media website, and 410 episodes on map website to finetune HTML-T5.
evidence.support_explanation: 训练 episode 数:与评测同三站点

evidence.quote: We prepare 20 different natural language instructions (see Appendix F for the full list), and measure the success rate and score for the evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 每站点 20 条指令

evidence.quote: We first evaluate WebAgent with the real-world navigation performance under human supervision
evidence.support_explanation: 真实评测在人监督下进行

evidence.quote: If the agents achieve 100 score, that episode will mark as success.
evidence.support_explanation: 成功=属性覆盖 100%
WebAgent 成功率 65/70/80%
单 Flan-U-PaLM 基线 10/20/10%

evidence.quote: If they do not use language model modules, prompted Flan-U-PaLM plans in an open-loop manner ( Plan : ✗ ), and regular-expression-based retrieval summarizes given raw HTML ( Sum : ✗ ).
evidence.support_explanation: 基线=few-shot 开环规划+正则摘要(无微调)

evidence.quote: in real-estate , WebAgent generates incorrect plans in 70% of failure episodes
evidence.support_explanation: 失败主因:规划

evidence.quote: HTML-T5-Base (ours) | 12K | 57.0% | +3.2
evidence.support_explanation: HTML-T5 vs 同尺寸 LongT5 的 MiniWoB++ 增益(Base)

evidence.quote: HTML-T5-XL (ours) | 67.1 % | +6.7
HTML-T5-XL outperforms WebN-T5-XL ( Gur et al., 2022 ) , the prior best method, by 18.7%.
SoTA ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) | – | 99.2 % | –
evidence.support_explanation: 表内同列 ICL SoTA 99.2%(Synapse)

evidence.quote: Long-T5-Base | Local & Global | 53.1 % | 53.6 %
evidence.support_explanation: 局部+全局注意力 vs Flan-T5 稠密 34.0/35.3
长 span 去噪混合最佳(Base,单次)
HTML-T5-XL Mind2Web
MindAct GPT-4 行
Synapse 行(与 Synapse v3 自报略有不同:24.2/26.4、SR 0.6/1.5)

evidence.quote: Due to budget constraint, we only run GPT-4 on 50 50 tasks for each setting.
evidence.support_explanation: 固定来源:MindAct GPT-4 仅在每划分 50 个任务上评测;WebAgent 表未标注

evidence.quote: For GPT-4 we use 50 50 tasks for each setting with top- 10 10 candidates due to limited budget.
evidence.support_explanation: 固定来源:GPT-4 另用 top-10 候选
固定来源核对:WebAgent 表中 MindAct(Flan-T5-XL) 数值一致

evidence.quote: The results in Figure 9 imply that the performance of Flan-U-PaLM-540B and gpt-3.5-turbo are the same (80% success, 93.8% score)
evidence.support_explanation: 换生成器 LLM(map 站点)

evidence.quote: which, however, might cause additional computational costs and latency.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认模块化成本

evidence.quote: On the other hand, it is costly to evaluate the performance of autonomous agents in the real world.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认评测成本

evidence.quote: We have anonymized the real websites we tested on for safety and privacy concerns.
evidence.support_explanation: 站点匿名→不可复现

evidence.quote: Provided with few-shot generic examples (such as selecting checkboxes, entering text into inputs, clicking on options, and scrolling etc.) for program generation
evidence.support_explanation: 代码生成靠通用 few-shot 示例

evidence.quote: Furthermore, we finetune HTML-T5-XL with 347K demonstrations from Furuta et al. (2023) , which performs better than 11B-parameter Flan-T5-XXL even with 3B parameters, achieving 85.6% success.
evidence.support_explanation: 数据规模对比

signatures.object: web agent 的角色分解(基线=单个 LLM 按提示扮演各角色)
signatures.information: 原始 HTML(含 data-ref 标注,去除 script/meta)+ 用户指令 + 此前子指令历史
signatures.operation: HTML-T5(微调编码器-解码器)输出下一子指令并抽取相关 data-ref;按 ref 取 HTML 片段;Flan-U-PaLM(540B)few-shot 把子指令+片段生成 Selenium Python 代码并执行;循环到结束子指令或迭代上限
signatures.output: 可执行 Selenium 程序(开放动作空间)
signatures.conditions: 能获取 data-ref;生成器 LLM 有足够代码能力(换 8B 失败,62B 60%)
signatures.feedback: 下一页 HTML;执行错误仅在训练数据采集时用于过滤
signatures.selection_rule_data: 无推理期选择;训练期过滤编程/检索/URL 关键失败
signatures.persistence: 子指令历史在上下文内
signatures.claimed_effect: 真实站点成功率 65/70/80% vs 单 LLM 10–30%
signatures.failure_boundary: 规划错误占失败主因;程序错误无反馈回路;站点匿名/20 指令

signatures.object: 规划/摘要模型的训练数据(self-experience supervision)
signatures.information: 指令模板+槽值随机采样;规则解析器分解子指令并用正则取 ref;Flan-U-PaLM 提示生成程序;环境反馈剔除关键失败;约 260/230/410 条 episode
signatures.operation: 模板采样→脚本化规划/摘要标签→提示式程序合成→执行并过滤→微调 HTML-T5
signatures.output: 每站点领域 HTML-T5 规划+摘要模型
signatures.conditions: 站点可脚本化、可手写模板
signatures.feedback: 执行错误/检索错误/错误 URL 前缀
signatures.selection_rule_data: 仅剔除‘关键失败’,不验证成功;未报告阈值
signatures.persistence: 微调后的 HTML-T5 权重
signatures.failure_boundary: 仅 3 站点、评测同站点;规则解析器与模板为人手写

signatures.object: HTML 编码器与预训练目标(基线=稠密注意力/instruction-tuned LongT5)
signatures.operation: LongT5 的局部+瞬态全局注意力 + 长 span(μ∈{8,64})去噪混合,再下游微调
signatures.conditions: HTML 层次结构;需 PEGASUS 初始化(消融 67.11→82.46)
signatures.feedback: 下游 MiniWoB++/Mind2Web/real-estate 离线规划
signatures.failure_boundary: 架构增益主要来自借用的 LongT5 局部+全局注意力(34.0→53.1),去噪增益较小;Description Generation 上 HTML-T5≈LongT5

retention_trace.reason: WebAgent 的 self-experience 是‘自采数据→微调规划/摘要模型’的静态训练流程,不声称持续自我改进;按训练设计评价。
retention_trace.before: 提示式 Flan-U-PaLM(开环规划+正则摘要)
retention_trace.proposed_change: 用脚本+LLM 采集的 260/230/410 episode 微调 HTML-T5 规划/摘要
retention_trace.selection_data_rule: 仅剔除程序执行/检索/URL 关键失败
retention_trace.later_tasks: 同三个站点的 20 条指令(是否与训练模板重叠未报告)
retention_trace.measured_gain: 成功率 10/20/10% → 65/70/80%(含两处改动:微调+闭环规划/摘要)
retention_trace.verdict: task improvement 为作者报告;未区分‘微调’与‘自采数据来源’;无 retained/improver 独立证据。

gap.author_gap: 真实网站上:无预定义动作空间、HTML 远长于模拟器(7–14K vs 0.5K tokens)、通用 LLM 缺 HTML 结构先验
gap.checked_gap: token 统计有图表证据;‘缺 HTML 先验’由 HTML-T5 的 MiniWoB++ 同数据对照间接支持(局部+全局 53.1 vs 稠密 34.0);‘开放动作空间需要代码’是设计论点。MindAct(已固定)是最近邻:其 summarizer+actor+MCQ 在离线数据集上
